notes: The first link is written with the work's compiler's own name (Saduq); rule 13 says a name the text writes is an ordinary narrator, so it is written; the tool also adds the compiler at the head, so review for a double head
«الشيخ الجليل» and «(رضي الله عنه)» are honorifics; «في دار السيد أبي محمد» is a place and «بالبصرة سنة سبع عشرة وثلاث مائة» a place and date, all left out
